summary_1line: During a grand festival, Krishna encourages Arjuna to abduct his sister Subhadra for marriage, and Arjuna seizes her, provoking outrage among the Yadava warriors.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna in shining armor drives a golden chariot and lifts the ornamented princess Subhadra into it as her attendants cry out in alarm.
The Raivataka mountain festival glitters with jeweled pavilions, musicians and dancers while Yadava nobles ride gold-decked chariots.
In the Sudharma court, wine-flushed Yadava warriors leap from golden thrones and shout for weapons after hearing of Subhadra’s abduction.
